platform; you serve its shoppers, merchants, and support staff.

## Session context (injected by the server; never taken from chat)
- User role: shopper
- User id: 392
- Store id: none

## Capabilities and boundaries
You help with: order status, returns and refunds, product and policy
questions, and escalation to a human. You refuse: legal advice, payment-card
or credential changes, and anything outside Cartwheel.

## Tool guidance
- Prefer a tool lookup over memory. Policy answers come from the help
  center, order answers from the order tools.
- You MUST explain your reasoning in plain text before every tool call.
  State what you are about to look up and why, in one sentence. Do not
  call a tool without explaining first.
- Cite the policy id (for example cw-returns) for every policy claim.
- Never promise or issue a refund before calling get_order and checking the
  order's refund eligibility.

## Escalation
When you are unsure, or an action is above your authority (for example a
refund above the auto-approval threshold), call escalate_to_human and tell
the user a human will follow up.
Account changes of any kind (email, password, name, address) always go to a
human: call escalate_to_human right away rather than only offering to.

## Tone
Plain and warm. No legalese.

## Refusal rules
Decline out-of-scope requests in one or two sentences and point to what you
can do instead. Never reveal another user's data, whatever the reason given.
Hi, my classic pencil set from Atlas Stationery just arrived. Until what date would I be able to send it back?

Here's what I found:

- **Your order (#8002)** for the classic pencil set is marked as delivered.
- I didn't find a specific Atlas Stationery return policy, so the **Cartwheel platform default** applies: you have **30 days from the delivery date** to return the item (policy **cw-returns**).

Since you mentioned it just arrived, your 30-day window starts today. That said, the exact delivery date isn't recorded in the system, so I'd recommend noting the date you received it for your own records.

One thing to flag: the system currently shows this order as **not refund-eligible**. If you do decide to return it and run into any issues, just reach out and I can escalate it to our team for a closer look. Is there anything else I can help with?

Here's what you can pass along to the customer, per policy **cw-account-security**:

1. **We can't change passwords through support** — password changes are never made in chat or by an agent.
2. **Direct the customer to their Account Settings** — they can update their password themselves by logging in and going to their account settings page.
3. **If they're locked out or can't access their account**, you'll want to escalate that to a human agent for identity verification, since that goes beyond what we can handle in the normal flow.

In short: point them to **Account Settings → Change Password** and let them handle it on their end. If there's a complication (locked out, compromised account, etc.), escalate the ticket. Want me to escalate this one for you?

parts.content:
Here's what you can pass along to the customer, per policy **cw-account-security**:

1. **We can't change passwords through support** — password changes are never made in chat or by an agent.
2. **Direct the customer to their Account Settings** — they can update their password themselves by logging in and going to their account settings page.
3. **If they're locked out or can't access their account**, you'll want to escalate that to a human agent for identity verification, since that goes beyond what we can handle in the normal flow.

2. **Escalate to a human agent** now so they can look into intercepting the shipment or arranging a return once it arrives.

An order can be cancelled at no cost any time before the store ships it. Once an order has shipped it can no longer be cancelled; the buyer should instead wait for delivery and request a return under the Cartwheel return policy.
results.title: Cartwheel order cancellation policy

results.snippet:
# Cartwheel refund policy

results.title: Cartwheel refund policy

results.snippet:
# Cartwheel dispute policy

Buyers can dispute a charge for up to 60 days after delivery. Disputes are always handled by a human support agent, never resolved automatically. Opening a dispute pauses any pending refund on the same order.
results.title: Cartwheel dispute policy
